title: Reverse Nodes in K Group
summary: Reverse each complete consecutive block of k nodes in a linked list and return the new head.

contractDetails.constraints: The list has n nodes, where 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 5,000. Node values are integers in [0, 1,000]. The input has no cycle.

statement: Reverse each complete consecutive block of k nodes in a linked list and return the new head. Leave an incomplete final block in its original order. Rewire the original nodes without changing their values.

examples.explanation: Two pairs reverse, and 5 stays at the end.
The entire list is one complete block.
The final two nodes remain in order.

constraints: The list has n nodes, where 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 5,000. Node values are integers in [0, 1,000]. The input has no cycle.
hints: Conceptual: A block must contain k nodes before you start reversing it.
Directional: Keep a pointer just before the current block and locate the boundary beyond it.
Implementation: Reverse links inside that boundary, reconnect the preceding chain to the new first node, and use the old first node as the next predecessor.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space with iterative block reversal.
